name: Synthetic operational dataset and ML-MILP code for thread dyeing waste prediction and reverse logistics optimization
description: This dataset contains a literature-calibrated synthetic operational dataset representing two years (2023–2024) of daily production and waste-generation data from a thread dyeing facility, along with the accompanying Python code for machine learning model training (Random Forest, XGBoost) and Mixed Integer Linear Programming (MILP)-based reverse logistics optimization. The dataset includes 39 operational variables (production volume, dye batch count, chemical and dye usage, water and energy consumption, machine utilization) and four waste-stream targets (solid waste, yarn waste, chemical waste, wastewater), with all parameter ranges derived from published textile processing literature. Provided to support reproducibility of the associated work on predictive waste classification and reverse logistics optimization in a circular textile supply chain.
